summary: Read all 9 owned units s0020–s0028 in Chinese. No birth or age is stated. The only deaths are Muti and Siluohou (s0021, 皆斬之), both captured. 咸和九年 converts cleanly to AD 334 (Emperor Cheng; Xianhe 326–334). Post-Hui backing in s0020 correctly uses a 333–334 event window. Later same-year fights (旬余, 二旬) stay at year precision. One defect: hints-p010 lists discrete AD 333 though Duan Liao's pre–Xianhe 9 event is only a window. 35 of 36 items are supported. No definite English omission/mistranslation requiring a supplemental artifact.

references.quote: 咸和（ 326年二月—334年）是东晋皇帝晉成帝司馬衍的第一个年号，共计9年。
references.reason: Confirms Xianhe under Emperor Cheng ran AD 326–334 (9 years), so 咸和九年 = AD 334 at year precision.
